CIQP_Request_A00.Request_Key: Unique key of this request: case number and cycle.
CIQP_Request_A00.Case_Code: Beiersdorf's case number for this raw material (e.g. CIQ-2026-0001).
CIQP_Request_A00.Cycle_No: Which questionnaire cycle of the case this is (1 for the first).
CIQP_Request_A00.Supplier_Code: Beiersdorf's code for the supplier company.
CIQP_Request_A00.App_Case_Item_Id: Link to the twin case in Beiersdorf's internal app.
CIQP_Request_A00.Trade_Name: Trade name of the raw material, set by Beiersdorf.
CIQP_Request_A00.Main_INCI: Main INCI name of the raw material, set by Beiersdorf.
CIQP_Request_A00.BDF_Material_No: Beiersdorf's material number for the raw material.
CIQP_Request_A00.Supplier_Display_Name: Supplier company name shown to the supplier.
CIQP_Request_A00.BDF_Contact_Name: Beiersdorf contact person for this case.
CIQP_Request_A00.BDF_Contact_Email: E-mail address of the Beiersdorf contact person.
CIQP_Request_A00.Markets_Label: Target markets of the raw material, set by Beiersdorf.
CIQP_Request_A00.Template_Label: Name of the questionnaire version the supplier answers.
CIQP_Request_A00.Supplier_Due_Date: Date by which the supplier should complete the questionnaire; the step deadline and reminders follow it.
CIQP_Request_A00.Case_Contacts_JSON: The supplier contacts on this case, and which of them may confirm.
CIQP_Request_A00.Assigned_Contacts: Supplier contacts who get the questionnaire tasks.
CIQP_Request_A00.Rule_Set_Version: Version of the rules that decide which sections apply, pinned at the start.
CIQP_Request_A00.Template_Version: Version of the questionnaire, pinned at the start.
CIQP_Request_A00.Config_Bundle_JSON: The pinned questionnaire and rules (supplier-safe) that the portal screens render.
CIQP_Request_A00.Config_Bundle_Hash: Fingerprint of the pinned questionnaire, to detect any change.
CIQP_Request_A00.BDF_Set_JSON: Values Beiersdorf sets, shown to the supplier read-only.
CIQP_Request_A00.Config_Answers_JSON: The supplier's answers to the metadata questions that open and close sections.
CIQP_Request_A00.Answers_JSON: The supplier's answers to the questionnaire, by question.
CIQP_Request_A00.Answered_By_JSON: Who answered each question, and when.
CIQP_Request_A00.Justifications_JSON: The supplier's reasons where something cannot be provided.
CIQP_Request_A00.Components_JSON: The K2.1 composition table: one row per component.
CIQP_Request_A00.Scope_JSON: Which sections apply to this raw material, and why.
CIQP_Request_A00.Manual_Scope_JSON: Sections a Beiersdorf department added to the questionnaire.
CIQP_Request_A00.Requested_Docs_JSON: Documents the supplier is asked to upload, from the answers given.
CIQP_Request_A00.Answers_Rev: Save counter: goes up by one with every save.
CIQP_Request_A00.Answers_Changed_At: When the answers were last saved.
CIQP_Request_A00.Editing_By: Contact currently working on the questionnaire (shown to colleagues).
CIQP_Request_A00.Editing_Since: Since when that contact has been working on it.
CIQP_Request_A00.Completeness_Confirm: The supplier's confirmation that the questionnaire is complete.
CIQP_Request_A00.Completeness_By_Email: E-mail of the person who confirmed completeness.
CIQP_Request_A00.Completeness_By_Role: Role of the person who confirmed completeness.
CIQP_Request_A00.Case_Phase_Label: Where the case stands, in the supplier's words.
CIQP_Request_A00.Request_Locked: Yes while the supplier may change nothing (final release requested, or case closed).
CIQP_Request_A00.Questions_History_JSON: Every question from Beiersdorf with its full answer history.
CIQP_Request_A00.Release_At: When the final release was given.
CIQP_Request_A00.Change_Report_Text: A change the supplier reports after the release (Report a change).
CIQP_Request_A00.Change_Report_By_Email: Who sent the last change report.
CIQP_Request_A00.Change_Report_At: When the last change report was sent.
CIQP_Request_A00.Change_Reports_JSON: Receipts of the change reports Beiersdorf received.
CIQP_Request_A00.Keep_Open_Gate: Technical: keeps the request open so the supplier can always see it.
CIQP_Request_A00.Supplier_Files: Every file the supplier uploaded for this questionnaire.
CIQP_Request_A00.Release_Contacts: Supplier contacts who get the final-release step.
CIQP_Request_A00.Release_Flag: Set to Reopened when Beiersdorf reopens a review; sends the request back to editing.

CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_Section_Key: Questionnaire section the file belongs to.
CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_Field_Key: Question or requested document the file answers.
CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_Row_Id: Component row (K2.1) the file belongs to, if any.
CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_Doc_Kind: Kind of document, e.g. SDS, CoA or certificate.
CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_File: Not used: the file itself is kept in Supplier Files.
CIQP_Request_A00_Uploads.Upload_Attachment_Id: Link to the file in Supplier Files.

CIQP_Help_Article_A00.Article_Title: Title of the help article, as suppliers see it.
CIQP_Help_Article_A00.Sort_Order: Position of the article on the Help page (lowest first).
